name: Workspace name
author: Jankees van Woezik
description: Name and icon of the current workspace, and optionally the workspace indicators

barWidget.description: Name and icon of the current workspace, and optionally the workspace indicators

schema.label: Draw the workspace indicators
schema.description: A button per workspace, showing its icon where one is set and its number where none is. This stands in for the Workspaces widget rather than sitting beside it, so take that one out of the bar first.

schema.label: Keep the number beside the icon
schema.description: Show icon and number together instead of letting the icon stand in for the number. Each button grows past the single-character slot the stock indicators use.

schema.label: Workspaces always shown
schema.description: How many workspaces stand on the bar whether or not they exist yet. Anything beyond this that does exist is added on top, up to ten or this number, whichever is higher.
